decision_basis.product_finding: No evaluated broad provider satisfies every primary-source recall, provider-date, latency and diversity gate. The PRD assigns candidate discovery to search and final source/date authority to capture-backed local adjudication, so a single-provider all-gates integration rule is over-coupled.

supersession.superseded_assumption: one broad provider must independently pass locator recall provider-reported date accuracy latency diversity and primary-source authority before any role-specific integration can be considered
retained_hard_boundaries: provider date never becomes financial date authority
raw response must be captured before parse
cross-case and wrong-direction evidence fail closed

official_primary_lane.role: known primary disclosure and authoritative source discovery
routes: issuer IR RSS Atom JSON feed and sitemap
official-domain bounded index or same-host locator
capture-first official static fetch with dynamic-page fallback only when separately budgeted

semantic_open_web_lane.role: unknown customer supply industry mechanism and counterevidence locator discovery
semantic_open_web_lane.selection_reason: same-matrix live retrieved five of six frozen customer/supply case-slot primary targets and materially outperformed Tencent target recall

document_and_parser_lane.role: fetch verify parse and locally adjudicate discovered source

required_before_writer: capture-backed publication date or typed date gap

locator_route_hard_checks: bounded cost latency and retry behavior

requirements: compile route choice from EvidenceRequest source family and known-versus-unknown target state
reuse immutable Firecrawl Tencent DELL R2 and official capture evidence without network
keep Firecrawl locator rows candidate-only and Tencent outside the selected route
apply local canonical source date relationship and Evidence promotion gates after locator discovery
prove DELL MU NVDA required-slot scheduling duplicate accounting contamination rejection and typed route gaps
emit a SearchQualityCard separating locator-route contribution from portfolio Evidence qualification

stop_rules: do not rerun or patch Tencent
do not purchase or live-test another provider before the zero-call portfolio replay
do not rerank when the required target is absent from the combined candidate pool
do not promote Firecrawl snippets or provider dates
do not call the portfolio production-capable before a fresh combined-route live proof and downstream Evidence utilization proof
known_boundary: This decision corrects role ownership and selects the next deterministic implementation. It does not integrate Firecrawl, qualify an official route, close S1-08, produce Evidence, run Agentic Research or establish report quality or release readiness.
